release_stage: Complete reviewable software/research packet. Scientific publication and public deployment remain held for candidate/evidence review. This receipt does not assert a merge, hosted CI completion or live Pages verification.
software_verification_scope: Source and isolated installed-wheel checks; actual Windows launcher six checks and actual browser export/replay controls. These checks validate software behavior, not the physical adequacy of a measured lens model.

notebook_execution_scope.qualification: The first five notebooks and their earlier execution receipt are preserved; they are not relabeled as new RC6 executions.

scope: Exact reviewed RC6 source, wheel and 49-page paper with canonical notices and an unchanged synthetic animation. The provisional primary target Gaia18ajz is previously published, retains all eight mode/prior/near-far alternatives, and has no accepted independent native-data assessment in this release. The 1,808-model spectrum preserves failures, modes, native time groups and unavailable quantities; these are not 1,808 unique objects. It admits zero measured lens tracks. The older 155-direction atlas remains separately frozen at its historical source pin. A measured-angular-track route validates supplied lens positions and covariance using synthetic controls; it does not infer black-hole identity, mass or distance. Zero established new black holes and zero accepted independent known-black-hole recoveries remain. One Einstein/GHY optical response is interpreted as BHSM hypersurface topography and counted once. The envelope-boundary differential is author-defined and broader than conventional rotational frame dragging; no new spin or extended-halo classifier is established. Hashes establish byte consistency, not authenticity or physical adequacy.
native_observation_rights: Source-pack CC-BY4.0 author data and public HST terms remain in the ZIP and SOURCEPACK_CITATIONS_AND_RIGHTS.md; BHSM licensing does not replace them.
installation: Extract the portable product ZIP and open product/. Python 3.11+: Start_Blackhole_Tracker.cmd creates its own local environment. Other systems install with python -m pip install . in a dedicated environment, then python -m bhtracker serve --open. App navigation opens Primary target, Evidence spectrum, Moving lens, Candidate sky atlas, Unresolved photometry or Joint astrometry research. Moving lens also uses Start_Blackhole_Tracker_Moving_Lens.cmd or --page skytrack. Joint research explicitly requires the astrometry extra; opening a page does not install it. Use the installed environment for all CLI replay commands; the Windows launcher interpreter is product/.venv/Scripts/python.exe. Resolved/native fit ZIP replay, measured-track result JSON replay and metadata view replay are distinct workflows documented in the pinned researcher guide.
input_privacy: Local app binds loopback; static Museum does not upload measurements or run inference.
